intro: Demisette Cloyce is a human warlock trainer sequestered in the subterranean crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Operating under cover of the city's underbelly, she instructs practitioners of the fel arts and directs promising acolytes toward deeper, more dangerous arcane mysteries.

sections.t: The Crypts of the Slaughtered Lamb
p: While Stormwind's authorities maintain an outward veneer of order and holy righteousness, practitioners of fel magic convene in the dank cellars beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in the Mage Quarter. Demisette Cloyce makes her residence down within these catacombs, tutoring warlocks willing to brave the forbidden arts. She holds little patience for the untrained or the uninitiated, advising her students that the dark energies corrupt only those lacking the discipline to master them.

Demisette is far more than a simple spell tutor; she serves as an essential nexus for warlock operations across Azeroth. When an acolyte reaches sufficient mastery, she directs them far beyond the walls of Stormwind—connecting them to powerful summoners like Menara Voidrender in the Barrens to harness potent artifacts and bind formidable fel steeds.
